name: W Montreal
insider_take: This sleek designer hotel brings Manhattan-style sophistication to Montreal's historic Vieux-Port, where cobblestone streets meet cutting-edge style.
whats_special: The W Montreal occupies a stunning converted 1920s Gare Viger train station and features Quebec's only rooftop bar with 360-degree city views. The hotel sits in Old Montreal, a UNESCO World Heritage area with 400-year-old architecture, just steps from the Old Port's waterfront promenade.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite for panoramic views of both the St. Lawrence River and Mount Royal, and time your rooftop bar visit for sunset over the historic city skyline.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature Wunderbar rooftop lounge for craft cocktails with unbeatable views, plus easy walking access to Place Jacques-Cartier's street performers, Notre-Dame Basilica's stunning Gothic Revival architecture, and the underground city's climate-controlled shopping network.
pros: Prime downtown location in historic Old Montreal
Trendy W brand design with modern amenities
Vibrant nightlife scene with rooftop bar
Walking distance to major Montreal attractions
cons: Contemporary style may not suit traditional preferences
Urban setting with potential street noise
